description: This file contains the implementation of default and constructor-based stream namespace predicate providers for Orleans BroadcastChannel, including methods for pattern matching and predicate creation.

classes.name: DefaultChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides default predicates for stream namespace matching, supporting wildcards, regex, and exact matches.

classes.name: ConstructorChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides predicate instances constructed dynamically, based on type name and optional constructor arguments.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to parse the predicate pattern and instantiate the appropriate predicate object.

methods.name: FormatPattern
methods.description: Creates a formatted string pattern for predicate types, with optional constructor arguments.
